visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The video opens at the storefront of the DimDimSum restaurant in Taoyuan, showing a large wooden sign with the brand's logo in glowing white characters. The setting is a brightly lit, modern interior with warm wooden accents and a designated area for takeout orders marked with bilingual signage. (2) The scene shifts to a restaurant table where various steamed buns in bamboo baskets are showcased. The buns are artistically shaped like different animals, including pink pigs, a green turtle with a small red flag, black penguins, and white seals with bear-like features, all presented in traditional bamboo steamers. (3) A young boy wearing a red shirt is seen sitting at the table, intently using red chopsticks to poke holes into the eyes of a pig-shaped bun to simulate a runny nose with the custard filling. Beside him, a bowl of rice topped with grilled chicken, a fried egg, and green cabbage is served. (4) A woman with long brown hair and a black shirt is shown sitting next to the boy, holding a piece of translucent shrimp rice roll with her chopsticks. She looks at the camera and smiles while gesturing toward the food in the bustling, wood-paneled restaurant environment. (5) Close-up shots reveal the interiors of the various animal-shaped buns as they are broken apart, showing vibrant fillings like purple taro, dark red bean, and yellow custard. A young girl is then seen holding and eating a seal-shaped bun before the video concludes with a shot of the restaurant receipt.
